faqs.question: Why can't I find a Halloween film my friend abroad is watching on Netflix?
faqs.answer: Netflix's catalogue depends on the country you are in, and licensed films are often limited to certain countries or a set period. Search the title in your own app: if it says it isn't available in your country, no list can change that. Netflix originals travel far better than licensed films.

faqs.question: Is Hocus Pocus on Netflix?
faqs.answer: It was not in the 281-title Best Halloween Movies collection on Netflix US when we checked on 13 October 2026. Search for it in your own app, because availability differs by country and month.

faqs.question: What is the scariest Netflix original to watch on Halloween?
faqs.answer: On our own 1–5 scale, The Haunting of Hill House (2018, 10 episodes) and the Taiwanese film Incantation (2022, 111 minutes) are the only two at 5/5. Both carry a TV-MA label on Netflix US.

faqs.question: Which Netflix Halloween movie works for a five-year-old?
faqs.answer: The Bad Guys: Haunted Heist (2024) runs 24 minutes and is rated TV-Y on Netflix US, and we score it 1/5 for scares. For slightly older children, Nightbooks (2021, TV-PG, 103 minutes) is spookier but still mild.

faqs.question: Are there Hindi horror originals on Netflix for Halloween?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bulbbul (2020, 94 minutes), the three-episode series Ghoul (2018) and the five-episode Typewriter (2019) were all flagged as Netflix originals on Netflix US on 13 October 2026. Typewriter is the mildest of the three.

faqs.question: How long does it take to watch The Haunting of Hill House?
faqs.answer: It has 10 episodes running 42 to 71 minutes each. At three or more episodes a night, which is how binge-watching is usually defined in research, that is three or four evenings.

faqs.question: Is Wednesday a good Halloween binge for teenagers?
faqs.answer: It is the gentlest series on this list: two seasons and 16 episodes, rated TV-14 on Netflix US, and we score it 2/5 for scares. It is a Netflix original, so it is less likely to vanish than a licensed film.

faqs.question: Does Netflix warn you before a Halloween movie leaves?
faqs.answer: Netflix's Help Center says that when a licence is not renewed, it will give you a heads-up before the title leaves. Licensing depends on rights, regional popularity and cost, so licensed horror films are the ones to watch.

faqs.question: Do Netflix originals ever leave Netflix?
faqs.answer: Netflix's help pages say licensed titles may be available only in some countries or for a limited time; they do not make that warning about originals, which Netflix produces or holds exclusive rights to. That makes originals the safer bet, not a guarantee, and #Alive shows ownership can still differ by country.

faqs.question: Can I send someone a Halloween card to go with movie night?
faqs.answer: The SubhSandesh Halloween page is a one-person card: they walk through a little haunted house, read your letter by flashlight and answer 'Will you be my boo?'. It does not stream films or run a watch party.

# Halloween Movies on Netflix, Originals First and Date-Checked

The Halloween movies on Netflix you can count on are Netflix originals. On 13 October 2026 we opened all 31 title pages below on Netflix US, and Netflix itself flagged 26 as originals; the other five are licensed and can leave or differ by country. That same day, Netflix US's own Halloween collection held 281 titles.

Plan for a phone, too. On SubhSandesh, 48.3% of shared pages are opened on a phone and each averages 11.1 views, so anything you send around movie night is read in someone's hand. Below: what "original" means, 31 titles by category, a table, how to check your country, and where this list goes stale.

## What counts as a Netflix original, and why it matters in October?

A Netflix original is a film or series that Netflix produced or holds exclusive rights to, marked with a red "N" or "NETFLIX" logo on its artwork or details page. Netflix's help page on [how it licenses TV shows and movies](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/4976) says licensed titles, by contrast, "may only be available in certain countries or for a limited time."

That decides whether a list survives to next October. Netflix's [explanation of why titles leave](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/60541) names three factors: whether rights are still available, a title's popularity in a region, and licence cost.

The flag surprised us twice: *Hush* (2016) and the Spanish *Veronica* (2017), often called Netflix horror, are not flagged originals on Netflix US. We left both out.

## 31 Halloween titles on Netflix US, checked 13 October 2026

We opened each title page from a US connection on 13 October 2026 and recorded availability, the original flag and the US maturity label shown. Years are first release and runtimes are listed running times; scare level is our own 1–5 score.

### 1. Netflix original horror films (8)

These are the picks for adults who want a real scare. All eight were flagged original and available.

- ***Fear Street Part One: 1994*** (2021) · 107 min · R · scare 4/5 · original. Parts Two (110 min) and Three (114 min) follow, also R and original.
- ***His House*** (2020) · 93 min · TV-14 · scare 4/5 · original. South Sudanese asylum seekers find their English home is not empty.
- ***Gerald's Game*** (2017) · 103 min · TV-MA · scare 4/5 · original. Nearly all in one lake-house room.
- ***Apostle*** (2018) · 129 min · TV-MA · scare 4/5 · original. A cult on an isolated island, 1905.
- ***Frankenstein*** (2025) · 150 min · R · scare 3/5 · original. Guillermo del Toro's version of Mary Shelley; more gothic than gory.
- ***Fear Street: Prom Queen*** (2025) · 90 min · R · scare 3/5 · original. A 1988 prom with a killer.

### 2. Netflix original family and kids Halloween films (5)

Ratings here run from TV-Y to PG-13, so read the label against the youngest viewer. None goes above 2/5 on our scale.

- ***Hubie Halloween*** (2020) · 102 min · PG-13 · scare 1/5 · original. An Adam Sandler comedy set in Salem, Massachusetts.
- ***Nightbooks*** (2021) · 103 min · TV-PG · scare 2/5 · original. A boy must tell a witch a scary story every night.
- ***The Curse of Bridge Hollow*** (2022) · 91 min · TV-14 · scare 2/5 · original. Halloween decorations come alive in a small town.
- ***Wendell & Wild*** (2022) · 105 min · PG-13 · scare 2/5 · original. Two demons bargain with a punk teen.
- ***The Bad Guys: Haunted Heist*** (2024) · 24 min · TV-Y · scare 1/5 · original. Short enough for a five-year-old's attention span.

### 3. Netflix original horror series for a Halloween binge (5)

Netflix owns all five, so they are the safest thing to plan a week around. Episode counts let you budget the nights.

- ***The Haunting of Hill House*** (2018) · 10 episodes, 42–71 min · TV-MA · scare 5/5 · original.
- ***The Haunting of Bly Manor*** (2020) · 9 episodes, 46–66 min · TV-MA · scare 3/5 · original. More sad than frightening.
- ***Midnight Mass*** (2021) · 7 episodes, 60–71 min · TV-MA · scare 4/5 · original.
- ***The Fall of the House of Usher*** (2023) · 8 episodes, 57–77 min · TV-MA · scare 4/5 · original. It takes its title from an Edgar Allan Poe story.
- ***Wednesday*** (2022) · 2 seasons, 16 episodes, 48–69 min · TV-14 · scare 2/5 · original.

### 4. International Netflix originals: Korea, India, Spain and Taiwan (8)

These suit Indian viewers in particular: three are Hindi-language and seven come from Asia. All eight were flagged original.

- ***Kingdom*** (Korea, 2019) · 2 seasons, 12 episodes, 36–56 min · TV-MA · scare 4/5. A plague spreads through a Korean kingdom.
- ***All of Us Are Dead*** (Korea, 2022) · 12 episodes, 53–71 min · TV-MA · scare 4/5. A high school outbreak.
- ***#Alive*** (Korea, 2020) · 99 min · TV-MA · scare 3/5. Flagged original, though another firm released it in Korean cinemas.
- ***Bulbbul*** (India, 2020) · 94 min · TV-MA · scare 3/5. Hindi; a child bride grows up amid supernatural killings.
- ***Ghoul*** (India, 2018) · 3 episodes, about 45 min each · TV-MA · scare 4/5. Hindi and English, set in a military detention centre.
- ***Typewriter*** (India, 2019) · 5 episodes, 43–54 min · TV-MA · scare 2/5. Three friends hunt ghosts in an old Goa villa.
- ***Feria: The Darkest Light*** (Spain, 2022) · 8 episodes · TV-MA · scare 3/5.
- ***Incantation*** (Taiwan, 2022) · 111 min · TV-MA · scare 5/5. A mother shields her daughter from a curse; our only 5/5 film.

### 5. Licensed titles: check your region first (5)

These five were on Netflix US on 13 October 2026 but are not originals, so treat each as a maybe. Open the title in your own app before promising a screening.

- ***Halloween Ends*** (2022) · 111 min · R · scare 4/5 · licensed (Universal).
- ***Scream VI*** (2023) · 122 min · R · scare 4/5 · licensed (Paramount).
- ***The Black Phone*** (2022) · 103 min · R · scare 4/5 · licensed (Universal).
- ***Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3*** (2024) · 158 min · TV-14 · scare 2/5 · licensed. Hindi.
- ***Goosebumps 2: Haunted Halloween*** (2018) · 89 min · PG · scare 1/5 · licensed (Sony).

## Netflix Halloween titles compared: original vs licensed, 5 categories

The table sums up each group with one example, ownership and the check date. Scare is our editorial score, not a Netflix figure.

| Category | Example title | Original or licensed | Availability check | Scare range |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Horror films | *His House* (2020) | Original (8 of 8) | Netflix US, 13 Oct 2026 | 3–4/5 |
| Family and kids | *Nightbooks* (2021) | Original (5 of 5) | Netflix US, 13 Oct 2026 | 1–2/5 |
| Horror series | *Midnight Mass* (2021) | Original (5 of 5) | Netflix US, 13 Oct 2026 | 2–5/5 |
| International | *Bulbbul* (2020) | Original (8 of 8) | Netflix US, 13 Oct 2026 | 2–5/5 |
| Licensed films | *Halloween Ends* (2022) | Licensed (5 of 5) | Netflix US, 13 Oct 2026 | 1–4/5 |

Build the watch list from the first four rows. Treat the last row as a bonus you confirm on the night.

## How to find what's on Netflix in your country

What you see depends on where you are: Netflix's help page on [using Netflix outside your home](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/24853) warns the selection of shows and movies may differ abroad. Four checks settle it.

- **Search the title, not a list.** "This title currently isn't available in your country" means it is not on your Netflix.
- **Look for the red "N".** It marks an original on the artwork or details page.
- **Open the Halloween row.** On 13 October 2026 Netflix US's [Best Halloween Movies collection](https://www.netflix.com/browse/genre/108663) listed 281 titles; your country's row will differ.
- **Browse by language.** Netflix's original-audio browser filters Hindi, Korean or Spanish titles.

Maturity labels also change by country. We list US labels, so an Indian account may show a different age rating.

## How many episodes is a Halloween binge?

Researchers usually define binge-watching as three or more hour-long episodes in one sitting. A [2022 study in *Psychologica Belgica* by Billaux and colleagues](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC9524295) used two hours and at least three episodes as the cut-off, and found that trouble-free binge-watchers shared little beyond that viewing pattern with problem viewers.

By that yardstick, *Hill House* is three or four sittings and *Ghoul* is one. Night is the usual slot for young Indian viewers: in a [2025 survey of 430 medical students in Bhubaneswar](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC12007762), 60.60% preferred watching at night and 69.07% mostly used a phone or tablet.

In the same study, 24.5% said their sleep cycle had suffered. On a school night, a 90-minute film beats an eight-episode series.

## Pairing a Netflix night with a card for one person

The [Halloween card page](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) is built for one recipient: they knock three times, carve a jack-o'-lantern until your word glows, read your letter by flashlight and answer "Will you be my boo?" It works in partner, bestie, family or kids mode, takes up to six photos and finishes with a 1080×1920 Boo License.

You get an email the first time they answer, and platform-wide, 90.9% of started SubhSandesh pages are published and shared. It is not a watch-party tool and it does not stream anything. If the movie night itself needs a yes, the [Invitation template](https://subhsandesh.in/date-invitation) asks the question and becomes a countdown once they accept.

## When this Netflix list is the wrong tool

We checked Netflix US only, on 13 October 2026, because that is where our connection landed; Indian, UK and Australian catalogues are unverified. Originals are the most stable bet, but #Alive shows ownership can differ by country.

Outside the US, the four checks above matter more than any list. A shared watch across countries needs everyone on the same catalogue, which SubhSandesh cannot fix, and the card page's interface is English only.

structuralLimitations: Availability verified on Netflix US only (the fetch geolocated to US, locale en-US) on 13 October 2026. Indian, UK, Canadian and Australian catalogues could not be checked; the post says so and gives the reader a country check instead.

Prompt framing 'originals stay on Netflix globally' is only partly supported: Netflix Help (node 4976) says originals are produced or held under exclusive rights and that LICENSED titles may be limited by country/time, but makes no global guarantee for originals. #Alive is flagged original on Netflix US yet was released in Korean cinemas by Lotte. Hush (2016) and Veronica (2017), commonly called Netflix horror, are NOT flagged original on Netflix US and were excluded.

Logged-out netflix.com title pages do not show runtime. Runtimes are from each title's Wikipedia infobox running time (cross-checked against Wikidata P2047; Wikidata's 120 min for Nightbooks was wrong, infobox 103 min used). Feria's episode length is unlisted, so none is given.
Netflix displays the latest season's year for series (Wednesday 2025, Kingdom 2020, Sweet Home 2024); the post gives first-release years.
Maturity ratings are the US labels Netflix displayed; the post warns they differ by country.
Scare scores (1–5) are editorial, labelled as ours.

SERP measured with one WebSearch (US index), lower confidence than Google. top 10 had 8 weak/stale results (school paper 2018, netflixlife 2016/2020/2021 x4, macmyths 2024, creepycatalog 2022). aol.com result returned 404 (judged from snippet only).
Tudum and What's on Netflix did not appear in the measured top 10; netflix.com/help.netflix.com are cited as primary sources for catalogue facts, not as competitor content.
